value.tokenizer_identity: Tokenizer embedded in the SHA256-pinned GGUF; same model bytes and runtime binaries as frozen v1 run.

protocol.primary: Strict named RDF binding-set equality and complete_within_scope on all 24 supported cases, including invalid/rejected/abstained cases in denominator; preserve frozen v1 score. Exact expected-status model abstention on all 6 expected abstentions.
protocol.secondary: Separately report position-aligned projection columns, same projection width and exact RDF term metadata for both v1 and v2 executions. This is a reference-agreement diagnostic, not query equivalence. Rust v2 structural scores normalize names; frozen v1 structural scores remain unchanged.
protocol.containment: Separate JSON/contract validity, expanded-v1 validation, explicit valid model abstentions, deterministic preflight blocks, index/type/compiler rejection, wrong-but-executable outcomes under strict and positional metrics, scope/canary/SPARQL/tool boundary failures.
protocol.performance: Raw input/output token counts, stop_type/limit and truncated flags; fresh server per ontology, OS page cache not evicted, warm excludes first case, cold adds startup; 200ms sampled descendant aggregate RSS may double-count shared pages. Host work is not isolated.
protocol.uncertainty: Descriptive Wilson 95% intervals for proportions; tiny correlated public synthetic paired AI-authored reference cases, not independent expert accuracy or Phase 0 GO.
protocol.confounds: v1 oracle gold-ID shortlist vs v2 all authorized Rust IDs with at most four labels; prompts/grammar/IR/scoring and post-v1 deterministic preflight differ. This is a controlled route comparison, not attribution to output length alone.
protocol.decision: If syntax improves but semantic answer agreement remains near zero, recommend deterministic templates/explicit confirmation or a separately versioned model change. Do not repeat identical runs or tune on sealed holdout.

measurement_rules: These are proposed engineering budgets, not expected or observed performance.
All prerequisites and gates are conjunctive; unapproved or unmeasured gates have no decision.
End-to-end includes catalog, prompt construction, model generation, Rust validation, SPARQL and evidence.
Cold first answer includes process and model startup; record cached versus uncached asset conditions.
Report p50/p95/p99, sample counts, retries, failures, timeouts, per-family results and 95% uncertainty intervals.
A zero-error small sample is not proof of a zero population error rate.
Exact answer accuracy uses all supported questions as denominator, including false abstentions and execution failures.
Wrong-plan execution and unflagged user-facing wrong-plan answers are distinct metrics; report both.
Define human semantic adjudication and conservative structural-equality treatment before the holdout.
If quality or CPU gates fail, revise scope/model or require confirmation and retest on an independent holdout.
Stop the current experiment immediately for an authorization boundary failure; repair and rerun deterministic tests first.
A stop-for-free-form-Ask decision requires documented failed revisions or inability to meet the approved constraints; Find remains separate.

value.change_reason: Add explicitly approved, waiver-bound AI-reference-only external evaluation, preserving independent human review as a formal GO prerequisite. Retain v2 complete-answer scoring.
value.reference_policy: AI-authored/AI-reviewed agreement; an approved ai_reference_only experiment must bind the owner gold-risk waiver SHA256 and is never eligible for formal GO. independent_human_review remains the default and a formal GO prerequisite; human-only review ledgers are unchanged.
value.structural_policy: Exact ordered IR, variable-name-sensitive; no unreviewed equivalence normalization
value.binding_policy: Exact RDF-term and variable-name binding sets; duplicates ignored; exact-answer gates additionally require complete_within_scope=true, with missing execution completeness unavailable; raw binding agreement remains separate; macro P/R/F1 over ALL supported cases, failed attempts score zero
value.abstention_policy: Correct only for matching expected status; parsing_error is not correct unsupported/clarification; all supported cases remain in answer denominators
value.uncertainty_policy: Wilson 95% for rates; fixed-seed 7, 1000-resample percentile bootstrap for macro P/R/F1; descriptive under correlated templates
value.sampling_policy: No reliability conclusion from zero errors; report every family/sample size/interval. Adequate decision sample sizes require human approval before holdout.
value.retrieval_policy: Oracle vocabulary baseline; retrieval disabled is not a measured retrieval success or failure
value.missing_fact_policy: Empty graph bindings do not establish real-world falsity; unknown without independent completeness annotation
value.timing_policy: All attempts, failures and timeouts; warm excludes first case; cold adds model and Rust/snapshot startup; OS cache explicitly recorded, never assume uncached disk
value.safety_policy: STOP on observed unauthorized execution/disclosure or prohibited query/write, including before approvals; rejected proposals do not count as boundary violations
value.locked_policy: Public Rust and Python runners refuse locked evaluation. The isolated locked_phase0.py operator adapter requires approved versioned freeze, exact commitment, subsequent explicit operator authorization, frozen target hardware/model/compiler/runtime and split-integrity evidence. independent_human_review requires complete external case reviews; explicitly approved ai_reference_only requires the exact owner gold-risk waiver and reports the absent independent review. It remaps only private transport copies to reuse the same Rust scorer, restores original locked identities in reports, refuses CI and keeps all private payloads/logs outside the public repository. One-shot custody across hosts remains the external operator responsibility.
value.change_policy: Append new approval revision, reason and previous freeze SHA256; fresh independent evaluation required after exposure. Prior receipts and decisions are never rewritten. Checksums provide integrity, not authenticated signatures.
